assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one original premium photorealistic website hero background for Stoquify, a business operating system for retail and distribution. Wide 16:9 cinematic composition, ideally 2560x1440. Scene: a beautiful contemporary West/Central African coastal commercial courtyard seen from an elevated shaded open-air studio, refined sand-colored stone arcades, restrained terracotta, sculptural tropical greenery, quiet teal glazed storefronts and an airy distant blue sea horizon. Foreground lower center: a curved walnut counter with an open unbranded slim laptop, a small neat stack of neutral inventory cartons and one ceramic vessel, no office chair. Suggest connected everyday commerce, clarity, calm ambition and room to grow. The upper 45 percent must be very calm low-detail slate-blue atmospheric sky and shaded architectural negative space suitable for centered white headline and buttons; no objects or bright sun behind that text zone. Keep central subject in lower half so it survives a centered portrait crop. Natural early morning light from the side, rich deep blue-green shadows, warm highlights, authentic architectural texture, sophisticated editorial photography, believable proportions, exceptionally polished. No written text, logos, watermark, charts, text overlays or UI. Avoid mountain valleys, rivers, forest cliffs, isolated office desk in wilderness, banking imagery, futuristic neon, crowded scene or recognizable existing website artwork. This is an entirely new composition; no reference image is being supplied.
